methods.name: Stage-Progression

data.narrative:
Re:Build Manufacturing is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Miles Arnone, Jeff Wilke, Anthony Manzo, and Michael Foley. The company has raised $545M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public and 8 private—spanning the robotics and advanced manufacturing sector, including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods apply to this stage and sector. Stage-progression analysis uses the $545M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $1.1B. Peer-median valuation across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median of $1.7B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. The peer set spans from Seed-stage Walden Robotics at $1.1B to Series B positions including Generalist AI at $2.0B and Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $926M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median estimate of $1.4B. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage discount relative to Series B peers—most comparables are further advanced—and the degree to which Re:Build's capital efficiency and burn profile align with or diverge from peer trajectories. The wide peer range reflects material dispersion in how market participants have valued robotics companies at comparable stages.
